title: HSK 1–6 cumulative (2026 syllabus)
oneLiner: Every word in bands t1 through t6 of HSK 3.0.
description: Bands 1 through 6 of HSK 3.0 (2026) unioned — the whole syllabus short of the advanced level. Closure is asserted at band 6.
rationale: The scope most learners mean by 'the HSK list', and the direct comparison point against the old HSK 2.0 1–6 vocabulary.

provenance.rule: The headword's 2026 band label is 6 or lower.
